home.title: Hôtel Lynx — your base in Agadir · 2-star hotel in Talborjt
home.description: Clean rooms, a 24-hour reception, free Wi-Fi and free public parking right by the hotel. A 2-star city hotel in Talborjt, opposite the Mohammed V Mosque. 8.4 on Booking.com.

rooms.title: Rooms — Single, Superior Single, Twin, Double, Triple · Hôtel Lynx Agadir
rooms.description: Five room types from 15 to 20 m², all with air-conditioning, a private shower room, flat-screen TV and free Wi-Fi. What every room has, and what we don’t do.

agadir.title: Your Agadir from Lynx — walking times from our door in Talborjt
agadir.description: Cafés 3 minutes away, the pharmacy 2, the beach promenade 23 — walking times along the streets from the door of Hôtel Lynx. With two maps and taxi times to the bus stations and airport.

basics.title: Practical info — check-in, parking, getting here · Hôtel Lynx Agadir
basics.description: Check-in 12:00–22:00, reception 24 hours, free public parking right by the hotel. How to get here from the airport and bus stations, house rules and answers before you book.

ask.title: Ask for a room — Hôtel Lynx, Agadir
ask.description: Tell us your dates and ask what’s free and today’s price. The form writes a clear email to our reception — or call us, 24 hours a day.

hero.lead: Clean rooms, a reception that never closes, free Wi-Fi and free public parking right by the hotel. In the middle of Talborjt, opposite the Mohammed V Mosque.
hero.alt: The front of Hôtel Lynx in Talborjt: a three-storey pink building with wrought-iron balconies, a row of flags and the black HOTEL LYNX sign above the entrance.
hero.og_alt: The pink façade of Hôtel Lynx with its black HOTEL LYNX sign, Talborjt, Agadir.

basics.intro: We’re a two-star city hotel and happy with it. Here’s the short version before you book.
basics.more: Times, getting here and questions before you book

yes.d: Guests score our cleanliness 8.9 on Booking.com.
Rated 9.5 by guests. Use it all you like.
Public spaces right by the hotel.
Someone at the desk, day and night.
Shower, toilet and towels in every room.
Over the roofs of Talborjt, facing the Kasbah hill.

no.d: We don’t serve it. Talborjt does — the first cafés are three minutes from the door.
Upper floors by the stairs only. Heavy bags? Ask at the desk for a hand.
The beach promenade is 23 minutes on foot, about 4 by taxi.

basics.img_alt: The reception of Hôtel Lynx: a lit wooden desk, carved chairs, a marble floor and the staircase with blue-tiled steps.

rooms.intro: Every room has air-conditioning, its own shower room, a flat-screen TV and free Wi-Fi. All non-smoking. No lift: the upper floors are by the stairs.

head.lead: Different beds, the same basics: clean, air-conditioned, your own shower room, free Wi-Fi. Here is each one, as it is.

items.d: In every room.
Shower, basin and toilet. No bathtubs.
Ready when you arrive.
Satellite and cable channels.
Guests rate it 9.5 on Booking.com.
Ask at reception.
Every room, no exceptions.
Ask at the desk.

every.img_alt: Shower room at Hôtel Lynx: a wall basin under a mirror, a towel rail, an open walk-in shower and a toilet on cream tiles.
every.img_cap: A Lynx shower room: shower, basin, toilet.

single.p: Our smallest room: 15 m² and one single bed, with everything on the list above. The sensible choice for one night between buses or a solo city stay.
single.nophoto: We don’t have a photo of the Single yet.

superior.p: 16 m² for one guest. It comes with a single bed or, when one is free, a large double bed — tell us which you’d like when you write.

photos.alt: A room at Hôtel Lynx with a large double bed, carved wooden wardrobe and a window onto the street flags.
photos.cap: Set up with the large double bed.

twin.p: 20 m² with two single beds. On Booking.com you’ll find this one listed as a Double Room with two single beds.

photos.alt: Twin room at Hôtel Lynx: two single beds with white linen, grey curtains, a wall-mounted TV and air-conditioning unit.

double.p: 20 m² with one large double bed. Some of our Doubles open onto a small wrought-iron balcony — we can’t promise one, but ask and we’ll try.

photos.alt: Double room at Hôtel Lynx: a large double bed, a table and chair, and the glass door open onto a wrought-iron balcony.
Another Double at Hôtel Lynx: a large double bed, a wooden chair and three dark wooden doors.

triple.p: 20 m² with a large double bed and a single bed: our room for three. We don’t add extra beds, so this is the one for a group of three.

photos.alt: Triple room at Hôtel Lynx: a single bed and a large double bed, table and chairs, grey curtains and a wall TV.
Another Triple at Hôtel Lynx: a large double and a single bed, a small round table with two chairs.
photos.cap: Another Triple, with a small round table.

photos.alt: A Triple at Hôtel Lynx with a double and a single bed, a wooden dressing table with mirror and a table with chairs.

None. Three of you? Book the Triple.
Every room is non-smoking.

nots.img_alt: The staircase of Hôtel Lynx: carved wooden balusters and steps with blue, red and yellow zellige tiles.
nots.img_cap: No lift. The tiled stairs instead.

balcony.p: Many of our rooms have a small balcony; some look towards the Kasbah hill. We can’t promise one, but tick the box when you write and we’ll do what we can.

quote.q: My room has balcony which i can see the kasbah at night which lit up nicely.

balcony.cta: Ask for a room with a balcony

agadir.h2: Most of it is a walk away.
agadir.intro: Talborjt is the town centre Agadir rebuilt after the 1960 earthquake: grills, cafés, banks, the big mosque. Walking times below follow the streets from our front door.
agadir.more: Two maps and every walking time
agadir.img_alt: The rooftop terrace of Hôtel Lynx at sunset: white wrought-iron chairs, the minaret of the Mohammed V Mosque on the left and the Kasbah hill on the right.
agadir.img_cap: From our roof: the Mohammed V minaret, Talborjt, and the Kasbah hill.
agadir.arrow_note: Arrows point the way as the crow flies.
agadir.ride_note: Times are by road, traffic permitting. Petits taxis pass all day in town; for the airport, ask reception about booking you a taxi.

head.lead: Talborjt is the town centre Agadir rebuilt after the 1960 earthquake. Walking times on this page follow the streets from our front door, at an easy pace — not as the crow flies. Taxi times are by road, traffic permitting.
head.img_alt: Through the blurred iron rail of a Hôtel Lynx balcony: Talborjt rooftops, palm trees, lit shops and the Kasbah hill behind.
head.img_cap: From a Lynx balcony: Talborjt and the Kasbah hill.

eat.intro: We don’t serve breakfast. Talborjt does, from the next street onwards.

quote.q: No breakfast cafe although loads of nice cafes nearby

errands.intro: Pharmacy, banks, the post office and groceries, all within seven minutes.

sights.intro: Gardens, two museums, the central market and the cable car — all on foot. Opening times change, so check them locally before you go.

beach.intro: Twenty-three minutes on foot to the promenade, twenty-five to the sand. Or about four minutes by petit taxi.

transport.intro: Petits taxis pass all day in town. For longer trips, ask at the desk.

restaurants.note: The nearest is 70 m from the door, with more on the streets around us.

airport.note: Petits taxis don’t serve the airport — ask reception about booking you a taxi.

arrive.p1: Check-in runs from 12:00 to 22:00, check-out by 12:00. Landing after 22:00? Call reception before you travel — the desk is staffed round the clock, so someone will pick up.
arrive.p2: Driving? Park for free in the public spaces right by the hotel. Coming from Al Massira airport, it’s about 24 km — ask us about booking you a taxi.
arrive.more: Getting here, house rules and questions
arrive.img_alt: Hôtel Lynx at blue hour seen from across the street: the lit HOTEL LYNX rooftop sign, street lamps and cars parked in front.
arrive.img_cap: Blue hour on Rue Al Mahdi Ibn Toumart. The lit sign on the roof is us.

head.lead: Times, parking, how to find us and the questions people ask before they book. If something isn’t here, call reception — someone is at the desk day and night.

ways.intro: We’re on Rue Al Mahdi Ibn Toumart in Talborjt, opposite the Mohammed V Mosque — the big minaret is your landmark.

items.d: Park for free in the public spaces right by the hotel. They’re public, so we can’t reserve one for you.
Al Massira airport is about 24 km away: about 30 minutes by taxi, traffic permitting. Petits taxis don’t serve the airport — ask us about booking one when you write.
The CTM bus station and the Supratours buses are each about 5 minutes away by petit taxi.
23 minutes on foot from the beach promenade, or about 4 minutes by petit taxi.
Arriving after 22:00? Call reception before you set off.
Ask at the desk if you need a little longer.
Every room. There’s no smoking room.
Pets are not allowed.
Upper floors by the stairs only, and the hotel isn’t wheelchair accessible.

items.a: No. The first cafés are 3–4 minutes from the door and Talborjt is full of them — see where.
Yes. Public spaces right by the hotel, free of charge. They’re public, so we can’t reserve one for you.
No — the upper floors are by the stairs only. Heavy bags? Ask at the desk for a hand. If stairs are hard for you, ask for a lower floor when you write.
Check-in is from 12:00 to 22:00. If you’ll be later, call reception before you travel and check with us first — the desk is staffed 24 hours.

items.q: Can you book an airport taxi?
items.a: Ask us when you write and reception will try to arrange one. The ride is about 30 minutes; petits taxis don’t go to the airport.
Yes, free. Guests rate it 9.5 on Booking.com.
We’re in the middle of Talborjt: the mosque is across the square and the streets are lively in the evening. Light sleeper? Mention it when you write.
No pool and no gym. The beach promenade is 23 minutes on foot.
It depends on the dates. Ask for a room or call reception for today’s price, or see our rates on Booking.com.

lead_quote.q: Friendly, Central, Clean and Simple Hotel

quotes.q: Convenient location. Great staff. We are returning guests. First visit was 19 years ago.
So clean. I had a fantastic stay. The hotels can be a gamble in Morocco, and this one was excellent.
Smooth and easy check in, all nice staff no matter which time of the day, clean room and room service, clean linen and towels , hot shower and good water pressure.

ask.intro: Tell us your dates and ask what’s free and today’s price. This form doesn’t book or charge anything: it writes a clear email to our reception, ready for you to send. Need an answer today? Call — reception is staffed 24 hours.

mini.intro: Pick your dates. The next step writes a clear email to our reception, ready for you to send — nothing is booked or charged.
mini.fine: Next: room, arrival time and your details.

steps: Fill in your dates and details. It takes a minute.
Your email app opens with the message written. Press send.
No email app on your phone? The message appears on screen to copy — or just call us.
Need an answer today? Call reception — it’s staffed 24 hours.
